description: The converter marks every member named like an access key sensitive, which catches `GcpBackupBucketProperties.accessKeyId` on a snapshot's bucket. The spec describes it as 'Access Key ID (HMAC key)': the public half of the key pair, an identifier like a key ID, while its secret (set only on the backup bucket requests) stays sensitive. IDs stay plain strings (distilled-sdk skill, Credentials). Source: the OpenAPI document served at https://api.clickhouse.cloud/v1 (2026-11-11).
